Maya L: Candidate (SRE II, UK) accepted verbally but got a local counter. Asking if we can move start earlier (Apr 3) and provide a temporary market uplift until comp panel meets. Deadline: needs relocation confirmation by tomorrow.
Anya (People Ops): please paste redacted numbers and timeline
Maya L: Offer: GBP85k base + 12% bonus, band cap GBP90k. Counter: GBP96k. Candidate suggests either a 6k sign-on or a temporary monthly top-up until band uplift. Wants to start Apr 3 vs Apr 24 because contractor notice period ends then.
Hector (Hiring): this is blocking a team migration. We can fund a one-time sign-on from hiring discretionary budget. Alternatively, hiring prefers monthly top-up to avoid big onboarding payout.
Ravi (Comp): policy allows provisional uplift or one-off sign-on for retention/geo parity but needs VP Eng + Finance approval. Recommend timebox: max 90 days and explicit review date. Also require clawback terms if uplift later not approved.
LegalBot: Suggested clause: "Provisional payment contingent on start date; final comp decision due by <date>; repayment pro rata if employee resigns within X months." Will draft wording for People Ops.
Payroll: Note payroll cutoff on Apr 5. If start Apr 3, sign-on must be submitted by Apr 2 to hit first payroll. Monthly top-ups require recurring payments setup; need finance approval for emergency payroll run if missed.
offer-bot: Automated check: "Action: provisional uplift OR one-time sign-on + start date modification. Required approvals: comp@, vp-engr@, finance@. Routing: comp -> vp -> finance. Estimated routing time 24-48h. Candidate deadline: 24h."
Anya (People Ops): Proposal: keep base GBP85k, add one-time provisional sign-on GBP6k payable on first payroll if starts by 2026-04-03; alternative: GBP2k/mo for 3 months. Condition: final comp review complete by 2026-06-01. Clawback: repay pro rata within 6 months if they leave. I'll draft both offer variants and route to Ravi + VP.
Hector (Hiring): I can justify the one-time sign-on in the business case and pledge hiring funds. Will ping VP Eng for expedited review.
Ravi (Comp): I'll prepare exception memo and recommended variant (one-time sign-on). Tagging @VP Eng.
Maya L: I'll tell candidate we expect provisional confirmation tomorrow AM and ask them to tentatively plan relocation. Thanks team. :relaxed:
Anya (People Ops): logging to exceptions tracker and attaching redacted comp docs. Will include payroll timing note for Finance.
